messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Alert — veridian-prod-euc dedicated-pool p99 = 3.2s (SLO 1.0s). Triggered at 2026-03-17T09:12:01Z.
Samir: paging eng-sre + eng-runtime. Veridian (enterprise, dedicated pool in eu-central) reporting sustained p95/p99 spike. Customer on-call loop opened.
Olivia: oncall here, taking lead. pulling metrics and logs now.
oncall-bot: @Olivia assigned to incident #INC-2026-0317-44
Maria: looking at Redis/KV cache hit rates + queue depth for veridian-euc-0. I see KV cache miss rate jumped ~15% at 09:10UTC.
Jia: seeing model-side token emit latency increases too, token service CPU on gpu-node-12 is pegged.
Tom: any recent deploys to that pool?
Olivia: no deploys in last 6h. autoscaling behaved but we hit an enqueue burst.
Samir: customer impact = interactive product search and chat degraded for a subset of Veridian users (EU-C). They reported timeouts and slow replies. Veridian-support is in the thread.
veridian-support: Confirming degraded response times for 30% of EU users since ~09:08UTC. Some sessions timed out. We've queued a customer-facing note.
Maria: metrics snippet: `pool=veridian-euc-0, queue_depth=142 -> baseline 12, p99=3.2s, cache_miss=0.23`
Jia: kernel-level logs from gpu-node-12:```
[09:09:42] kv_cache_miss_rate=0.22
[09:09:47] token_emit_latency=320ms
[09:10:01] queue_depth_increase
[09:10:10] model_worker_restart=soft
```
Olivia: mitigation plan: 1) divert new traffic for Veridian to warm-spare pool veridian-euc-1 (same region) 2) scale dedicated pool up by +2 warm workers 3) throttling for noisy tenant(s) if we identify one 4) fallback to hosted-lite model variant for degraded requests.
Samir: agree. Who can flip routing? Eng-platform?
Tom: I can run the routing change. Will push route: `route set veridian -> veridian-euc-1` then monitor.
Olivia: Maria, can you identify top tenant(s) hitting KV cache misses?
Maria: running a quick top-by-tenant query, returning now.
Maria: payload shows tenant T-42 and T-99 responsible for ~65% of additional requests. T-42 sessions have very large context window.
Jia: recommending we evict long-tail tenants from veridian-euc-0 temporarily. We can throttle T-42 to 10rps and migrate T-99 to veridian-euc-1.
Olivia: executing eviction + throttle: `./admin/tenant-isolate --pool veridian-euc-0 --tenant T-42 --rate 10`
oncall-bot: Command accepted, executing isolation.
Tom: routing flip started. `route apply veridian -> veridian-euc-1` — pushing now.
incidents-bot: route change propagated to edge at 09:16UTC.
Maria: pool veridian-euc-1 healthy, primed caches, p50/p95 improved for routed traffic. veridian-euc-0 queue depth falling from 142 -> 18.
veridian-support: seeing immediate improvement for users routed to the spare pool. Thanks.
Olivia: scaling up veridian-euc-0 by +2 warm workers to help backlog drain.
Jia: I'll monitor GPU and KV service. No signs of hardware OOM. Suspect workload pattern + cache eviction causing spin.
Samir: customer comms note: Veridian already informed that we're actively mitigating and routing customers to warm spare; full postmortem to follow.
Tom: I'll stay on this for 15m then hand off to next on-call.
Olivia: initial root-cause hypothesis: sudden large-context tenant causing cache churn and queueing on one dedicated pool. Immediate mitigations: routing to spare, tenant-isolate, scale.
Maria: saving logs + metrics snapshot. Attaching short extract for triage: `metrics_snapshot_6305004321.log`
Samir: next steps: 1) keep route in place until p99 < 0.9s for 15m 2) determine if tenant eviction must be permanent 3) plan config change to reduce single-tenant cache pressure (suggest: per-tenant cache caps) 4) coordinate RCA with Veridian.
Tom: p99 for affected endpoints now 0.85s for routed traffic (veridian-euc-1). Holding route.
Olivia: preparing handoff to @Tom (next on-call) in 10. summary -> mitigations executed and verified; action items logged.
Tom: acknowledged. I'll run a periodic check every 5m and update channel.
veridian-support: appreciate the fast response, please include timeline + action items in the follow-up.
Samir: thanks everyone. Adding incident label: customer-impact, dedicated-pool, tenant-isolation. Follow-up owners: Maria (triage data), Jia (infra fix), Samir (customer RCA).
Olivia: closing live warboard; moving to post-incident channel for RCA notes.
incidents-bot: incident #INC-2026-0317-44 marked as "mitigated" at 09:32UTC.
